numeric.selection: same seeded initialization/order; validation cross-entropy selects checkpoint; no test-driven epoch selection
numeric.limitation: one random row split; combined heart provenance/cohort separation unverified; offline experiment, not clinical validation

regularization.selection: validation objective (cross-entropy plus L2 penalty where present); test data selects no checkpoint or setting
regularization.limitation: 30-epoch maximum and one seeded row split; no 300-epoch historical reproduction, clinical validity or claim that regularization universally improves performance

sequence.encoding: official Keras IMDB word indices, not a newly fitted vocabulary; review prefixes truncated at 100 tokens
sequence.selection: validation loss selects checkpoint; official test subset never selects an epoch
sequence.limitation: one-seed balanced subsets; provided token encoding and truncation; no broad sentiment reliability claim

vision.selection: validation cross-entropy; normalization fits training pixels; augmentation only on training batches
vision.limitation: five-epoch balanced CIFAR subsets; no full benchmark, Cats/Dogs or six-landscape dataset reproduction claim

momentum.variant: exponential-gradient momentum includes (1-beta); RMSProp epsilon inside sqrt; Adam epsilon outside sqrt

rmsprop.variant: exponential-gradient momentum includes (1-beta); RMSProp epsilon inside sqrt; Adam epsilon outside sqrt

adam.variant: exponential-gradient momentum includes (1-beta); RMSProp epsilon inside sqrt; Adam epsilon outside sqrt
